zh: 图像两侧边缘和下边缘有大面积密集黑色区域。
不规则浅色间隙把中央近似竖向区域分隔开。
深色残片打断了可连续追踪的外部轮廓。
右上方有一个带小浅色缺口的密集黑色笔画组。
左下方的宽大深色区域中有分散的浅色开口。
这张阈值化图像需要更清晰的原始扫描后再细看。
en: Dense black areas occupy both side margins and the lower edge.
Irregular pale gaps divide a mostly vertical central band.
Dark fragments interrupt any continuous outer contour.
A compact black cluster with small pale notches appears at upper right.
A broad dark mass at lower left contains isolated pale openings.
The thresholded image needs a clearer source scan before close analysis.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
